title: [Feature Request]: Nested chats should be able to run asynchronously
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

We currently have a `register_nested_chats` which you can use to run nested chats. However, if your agents are augmented with async replies (aka using capabilities or subclassing where `register_reply` takes an async coroutine), then they cannot be run correctly with register_nested_chats because it uses `initiate_chats` internally instead of `a_initiate_chats`

### Describe the solution you'd like

linked_prs.title: Support async nested chats
linked_prs.body:
Ported from #3289

<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please review https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/docs/Contribute before opening a pull request. -->

In this PR:
1. We add a new `use_async` flag to `register_nested_chats` function. This allows the nested chats to internally run `a_initiate_chats` instead of `initiate_chats`.
2. Added a number of non-open-ai dependent tests for nested chats.

<!-- Please add a reviewer to the assignee section when you create a PR. If you don't have the access to it, we will shortly find a reviewer and assign them to your PR. -->

## Why are these changes needed?

<!-- Please give a short summary of the change and the problem this solves. -->
We support nested chats and async initiate_chats. However, if a chat is started asynchronously, nested chats still currently run in-process.

## Related issue number

<!-- For example: "Closes #1234" -->
Closes #3286
